opportunities.name: TMC Exam Digital Study Guide / Practice-Question PDF
opportunities.summary: RT students preparing for the NBRC TMC exam already pay $7-30 on Etsy for PDF study guides and 100+ question packs with rationales. Multiple independent sellers have double-digit review counts, showing repeat, ongoing willingness to pay for exam-specific PDFs. Dustan's RRT credential and TMC/CSE first-hand experience could differentiate a new entrant from anonymous sellers.

claims.statement: Etsy 'TMC Exam Study Guide, 101 Test Questions' listing shows 23 reviews, priced $9.99, sale $7.49.
claims.source_excerpt: TMC Exam Study Guide, 101 Test Questions (Digital Download) (23) Sale Price $7.49 $9.99 (25% off)

claims.statement: A second, separate Etsy TMC study guide listing (73-page NBRC-based prep) has 4 reviews at 4.4 stars.
claims.source_excerpt: Rating 4.4(4) ... This detailed 73-page study guide is designed to be the only resource you need to pass the TMC Exam.

claims.statement: NBRC TMC exam fee is $190 for new applicants, $150 for repeat applicants, a real cost that motivates paid prep purchases.
claims.source_excerpt: The TMC Examination costs $190 for new applicants and $150 for repeat applicants.

claims.statement: Several independently-run Etsy shops target the same 'TMC exam study guide' keyword cluster, suggesting a validated recurring search niche.
claims.source_excerpt: Multiple distinct listings (73-page guide, 101-question guide, 85-page guide) all ranking for 'TMC exam study guide'.

opportunities.owned_channel: Dustan's RT social accounts (organic), Gumroad store; can cross-list to Etsy
opportunities.fulfillment: One-time PDF written and formatted once; delivered as an automatic digital download. Zero marginal cost per sale.
opportunities.first_dollar_path: Write a differentiated TMC PDF guide leveraging RRT credential, list on Gumroad, post a free-sample excerpt to r/respiratorytherapy and RT TikTok within 30 days.
why_it_might_fail: Crowded niche with many similarly-titled Etsy competitors already holding reviews and SEO position.
Students often default to free alternatives (Quizlet, Studystack) before paying.
No brand recognition yet vs. established sellers with review history.

opportunities.name: Ventilator Modes / Mechanical Ventilation Cheat Sheet
opportunities.summary: One-page vent-mode and settings cheat sheets sell on Etsy for roughly $5-12, marketed jointly to nurses and respiratory therapists. This matches the RT + adjacent-clinician (ICU nursing) audience Dustan can reach, and his RRT background lends clinical authority over generic sellers.

claims.statement: Etsy listing 'Ventilator Modes Study Guide | Vent Cheat Sheet for Respiratory Therapists and Nurses' sells as an instant digital download.

claims.statement: 'Mechanical Ventilator Cheat Sheet' is explicitly marketed to nurses, doctors, and respiratory therapists together, not RTs alone.
claims.source_excerpt: This includes troubleshooting and maintenance tips, and is ideal for medical professionals including nurses, doctors, and respiratory therapists.

claims.statement: Multiple sellers cross-market vent cheat sheets to both nursing and RT buyers, indicating demand extends to adjacent clinicians as the brief expects.
claims.source_excerpt: Mechanical Ventilation Study Guide | Respiratory Therapy Cheat Sheet ... Volume Control Mode - Etsy

opportunities.owned_channel: Dustan's RT social accounts, Gumroad store, Etsy cross-listing
opportunities.fulfillment: Single-page PDF (and optional laminated print via Etsy print-on-demand); near-zero marginal cost.
opportunities.first_dollar_path: Publish an RRT-authored vent cheat sheet on Gumroad/Etsy, promote via short-form TikTok/Reels showing real vent settings explained.
why_it_might_fail: legal: a vent settings/troubleshooting reference can be read as clinical guidance and needs an explicit 'educational reference only, not a clinical protocol' disclaimer.
Saturated sub-niche; many nurse-authored competitors already have review history.

opportunities.name: ABG Interpretation Pocket Reference Card
opportunities.summary: ABG interpretation cheat sheets are one of the most repeated study-aid categories on Etsy, mostly authored by nurses for CCRN prep, priced roughly $4-15. RTs own ABG interpretation clinically, so an RRT-branded version credibly differentiates from the nurse-authored majority and reaches nursing students learning it too.

claims.statement: At least 8 distinct Etsy listings for ABG interpretation cheat sheets/bundles were found, most branded for nursing/CCRN prep rather than RT.
claims.source_excerpt: ABG Interpretation Cheat Sheet | CCRN Study Guide, ICU Notes, Arterial Blood Gas | Instant Download - Etsy

claims.statement: One ABG listing bundles 'causes and treatments' with interpretation steps, moving closer to clinical-advice territory than pure reference material.
claims.source_excerpt: This is a downloadable PDF ... includes a method for quick interpretation, compensation, and causes and treatments.

claims.statement: Nursing-branded ABG products outnumber RT-branded ones on Etsy, suggesting room for an NBRC/RRT-aligned version.
claims.source_excerpt: ABG Bundle, ABG Interpretation, Arterial Blood Gas Study Guide, ABG Practice Questions, Cheat Sheet, Nursing Notes - Etsy

opportunities.owned_channel: Dustan's RT social accounts, Gumroad store, Etsy cross-listing
opportunities.first_dollar_path: Publish an RRT-authored, NBRC-content-outline-aligned ABG card, explicitly labeled 'educational reference, not treatment guidance,' sell via Gumroad within 30 days.
why_it_might_fail: legal: any version implying treatment recommendations (not just interpretation) needs a clear non-clinical-advice disclaimer.
Very crowded, low-price niche where buyers may already own a nursing-branded equivalent.

opportunities.name: Low-Cost TMC/CSE Mini Prep Bundle
opportunities.summary: Established competitors charge $49-$375 for TMC/CSE prep bundles (video courses, test banks, practice exams), and RT students on Reddit name several of these as products they actually bought. A smaller, RRT-authored $49-79 mini-bundle (PDF workbook + short video walkthroughs) undercuts the incumbents while still monetizing proven willingness to pay well above flashcard/cheat-sheet prices.

opportunities.owned_channel: Dustan's RT social accounts, Gumroad store, Reddit/Facebook RT communities
opportunities.fulfillment: Pre-recorded short videos + PDF workbook, built once, sold repeatedly; higher build effort than a single PDF but still no per-unit fulfillment cost.
opportunities.first_dollar_path: Build a scoped-down mini-bundle (fewer modules than incumbents) at $49-59, sell via Gumroad, post value-add clips in the Reddit thread pattern where students already ask what to buy.
